posts.text: Today marks 12 years of our government's unwavering service to the nation. From 80 crore free rations to 90+ airports, from 4 crore pucca houses to making India the fastest-growing economy — this journey has been powered by the dreams and aspirations of 140 crore Indians. The best is yet to come.

posts.text: On this day in 2024, PM @narendramodi took the oath as Prime Minister for the third consecutive time. As the government completes 12 years, the journey of unprecedented development and welfare continues — building a Viksit Bharat for 140 crore citizens.

posts.text: Honourable Shri Narendra Modi ji took the oath of office as Prime Minister for the third consecutive time on this very day. Under Modi ji's leadership, over these 12 years, the country has witnessed for the first time the parallel realisation of poor welfare and unprecedented development. Modi ji has served the nation tirelessly through these 12 years without taking even a single day off.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh will recruit 1 lakh youth in the police force over the next two years. We are committed to building the safest and most developed UP. Our Film City in Greater Noida will be India's biggest — creating lakhs of jobs and putting UP on the global entertainment map.

posts.text: Substantive discussions at the 8th India-Indonesia Joint Commission Meeting. We covered political ties, defence, maritime cooperation, trade, fintech, health, critical minerals, and multilateral coordination. Glad to co-chair with FM Sugiono — our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership continues to deepen.

posts.text: Received a dividend cheque of ₹8,813 crore from SBI for FY 2025-26. SBI's robust performance — reporting ₹19,684 crore in Q4 net profit — continues to strengthen India's fiscal position. Also held productive discussions with West Bengal CM on accelerating development and expanding credit access.

Also held productive discussions with West Bengal CM on accelerating development and expanding credit access.

posts.text: The Adani Group's journey is a testament to India's growth story. With our combined market value at $191 billion across six listed companies, we continue to invest heavily in energy, infrastructure, and the technologies of the future. India's best decades are ahead of us.

posts.text: Reliance is building the businesses of the future. Our AI platform under Jio, partnerships with Google and Meta, and $11 billion AI data center in Andhra Pradesh position us at the forefront of India's digital transformation. We have no hesitation in believing we can build the future.
posts.caption: Reliance is building the businesses of the future. posts.text: India's entrepreneurial spirit has never been stronger. Young innovators across the country are proving that we can build world-class products and companies right here. The Tata legacy has always been about nation-building, and I'm encouraged by what I see every day.

posts.text: As the Government completes 12 years under PM Modi's leadership, I commend the tireless efforts towards inclusive development. From healthcare to infrastructure, from digital empowerment to global diplomacy — India stands stronger and more united than ever before.

posts.text: I have just been informed by our Great Military that last night the Iranians shot down one of our highly sophisticated Apache Helicopters while patrolling over the Strait of Hormuz. Both pilots are safe. Nevertheless, the United States must, of necessity, respond to this attack.
posts.caption: I have just been informed by our Great Military that last night the Iranians shot down one of our highly sophisticated Apache Helicopters while patrolling over the Strait of Hormuz. Both pilots are safe. Nevertheless, the United States must, of necessity, respond to this attack.

posts.text: Continuing to serve the people of Richmond and Northallerton as their MP. The Conservative Party must rebuild with clear principles — lower taxes, controlled immigration, and a strong economy. That's what I'm focused on delivering for my constituents and the country.
posts.caption: Continuing to serve the people of Richmond and Northallerton as their MP. The Conservative Party must rebuild with clear principles — lower taxes, controlled immigration, and a strong economy. That's what I'm focused on delivering for my constituents and the country.

posts.text: Honored to win the Republican nomination for Ohio Governor. We're going to bring real change to Ohio — cutting waste, empowering parents, and unleashing innovation. To every legal immigrant: you're like my parents. You deserve the opportunity to secure a better life in America.
posts.caption: Honored to win the Republican nomination for Ohio Governor. We're going to bring real change to Ohio — cutting waste, empowering parents, and unleashing innovation. To every legal immigrant: you're like my parents. You deserve the opportunity to secure a better life in America.

posts.text: Proud to continue supporting initiatives that strengthen American families and communities. My Indian heritage has taught me the value of education, hard work, and perseverance — values that make this country great.
posts.caption: Proud to continue supporting initiatives that strengthen American families and communities. My Indian heritage has taught me the value of education, hard work, and perseverance — values that make this country great.

posts.text: At the FBI, we're restoring the bureau to its core mission — protecting Americans from real threats. Accountability and transparency are not optional. We will continue to root out waste and ensure the American people can trust their institutions again.
posts.caption: At the FBI, we're restoring the bureau to its core mission — protecting Americans from real threats. Accountability and transparency are not optional. We will continue to root out waste and ensure the American people can trust their institutions again.

posts.text: Working on AI policy at the White House has been one of the most meaningful chapters of my career. America's lead in AI is not guaranteed — we need smart policy that encourages innovation while protecting national security. Excited about what's ahead.
posts.caption: Working on AI policy at the White House has been one of the most meaningful chapters of my career. America's lead in AI is not guaranteed — we need smart policy that encourages innovation while protecting national security. Excited about what's ahead.

posts.text: At the World Bank, we're focused on making development finance work for the most vulnerable. Climate adaptation, digital infrastructure, and private sector mobilization are our priorities. The scale of the challenge demands bold action — and we're delivering.
posts.caption: At the World Bank, we're focused on making development finance work for the most vulnerable. Climate adaptation, digital infrastructure, and private sector mobilization are our priorities. The scale of the challenge demands bold action — and we're delivering.

posts.text: Strengthening the UK's digital infrastructure and rolling out AI across the NHS — 500,000 healthcare workers will now have access to AI assistants. Early trials showed staff saving 43 minutes per day. That's millions of hours back to what matters most: caring for patients.
posts.caption: Strengthening the UK's digital infrastructure and rolling out AI across the NHS — 500,000 healthcare workers will now have access to AI assistants. Early trials showed staff saving 43 minutes per day. That's millions of hours back to what matters most: caring for patients.

posts.text: Australia is investing in the future — from clean energy to AI infrastructure. Our partnerships across the Indo-Pacific are stronger than ever. We're building an Australia that's more secure, more sustainable, and more connected to the region.
posts.caption: Australia is investing in the future — from clean energy to AI infrastructure. Our partnerships across the Indo-Pacific are stronger than ever. We're building an Australia that's more secure, more sustainable, and more connected to the region.

posts.text: L'Europe doit renforcer sa souveraineté technologique. France is leading the charge on AI regulation, nuclear energy, and defence. With the world in flux, our response must be unity, innovation, and strategic autonomy. Vive la France, vive l'Europe.

posts.text: Dubai continues to lead in innovation, AI adoption, and global connectivity. Our vision is clear — to make the UAE the best place in the world to live, work, and build. The future belongs to those who imagine it first and work hardest to make it real.

posts.text: SpaceX IPO this Thursday. $75 billion raise at $1.75 trillion valuation. We believe we have identified the largest actionable total addressable market in human history — $28.5 trillion. From Starlink to orbital AI data centers, the future is interplanetary. 🚀

posts.text: Our two biggest expenses are infrastructure and people. As we invest more in AI, we need to make hard tradeoffs. I wish I had a crystal ball for how the next three years of AI will play out. I don't. I don't think anyone does. But we're building for the long term.

posts.text: Excited to see Gemini powering the new Siri at Apple's WWDC. AI is the biggest platform shift of our lifetimes. We're on the cusp of hyperprogress — Google's $15 billion investment in India's AI infrastructure, data centers in space, and Waymo are just the beginning.

posts.text: Great to see NHS England scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot to more than 500,000 staff. In early trials, staff saved an average of 43 minutes per day, helping put more time back into what matters most — caring for patients. You need to give AI agents identities, sandboxes, and policies to govern them.

posts.text: We filed confidentially for an IPO. We expect it to leak so we're just announcing it. We haven't decided on timing yet — there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. OpenAI is now valued at $852 billion. The enterprise AI market is expanding rapidly.
posts.caption: We filed confidentially for an IPO. We expect it to leak so we're just announcing it. We haven't decided on timing yet — there are things we want to do that are likely easier as a private company. OpenAI is now valued at $852 billion. The enterprise AI market is expanding rapidly.

posts.text: What a journey this has been. My final WWDC as CEO — and I couldn't be more proud of what we've built together. Siri AI, iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate. Thank you to the incredible Apple team and our developer community. Here's to the next chapter. 🍎
